g.text: Focus ratio of whisper-tiny's input attribution (gradient × input with SmoothGrad) per test clip, by degradation
class. Values near 1 mean the model attends to degraded audio in proportion to its duration, not more; the overall
mean's confidence interval includes 1, so hypothesis H1 is refuted.
Focus ratio = share of the attribution that falls in degradation-flagged audio divided by the share of audio that is flagged (a 20
ms frame is flagged when the degradation detector AADD gives any class probability >= 0.5). Class = AADD's clip-level dominant
class; 'clean' clips here have a few flagged frames.
